The vendor directly providing **Slides** at **slides.com** is **Slides, Inc.**.

### Evidence:
* **Privacy Policy:** States, *"It is Slides, Inc.'s policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect while operating our websites."*
* **Website Notices & About Page:** The official pages at `slides.com` list the copyright ownership as *"© Slides, Inc."* and note the company was founded in 2013 by Hakim El Hattab and Owen Bossola as an independent, self-funded business.
